svg.title: NinaPro DB2: Aligned Windows and Independent Person Splits
svg.desc: Executed 40-person E1 source inventory, deterministic 300-ms label-pure paired window selection, 48/96 feature vectors and participant-disjoint Development and Test partitions.
svg.text: NINAPRO DB2: ALIGNED WINDOWS AND INDEPENDENT PERSON SPLITS
40 participants · 337,853 eligible source windows · 40,000 retained pairs · No model fitting
Window diagram is schematic; cohort counts and feature dimensions are recorded research outputs.
Original E1 data → source-safe paired windows → selected modelling cohort → features → person-disjoint evaluation
